- Option C (Flammable gas generation): This is likely, as many nitrogen-containing gases can be flammable. 
- Option D (Heat generation): Many chemical reactions, especially those involving acids and bases or reactive compounds like nitrides, generate heat.

Option E (Innocuous and non-flammable gas generation) is unlikely because the reaction typically involves reactive gases. Option H (Toxic gas generation) is also a possibility, as nitrogen compounds can be toxic.
